items.statement: Monthly in-situ simulation with structured debriefing will shorten the median time from call to first critical intervention in real adult ward calls by at least 2 minutes after introduction, adjusting for calendar time.
items.rationale: Consistent with the five-hospital evaluation (c1) and measurable with call records.
items.risks: Four clusters; secular trends; missed simulations.

items.statement: Hospitals that route latent safety threats into the tracking system will show larger improvements than those that do not.
items.rationale: Suggested by the latent threat study (c5).
items.risks: Cannot be estimated with four hospitals; qualitative only.

items.statement: Families will report clearer understanding of the team's roles after the programme, if scenarios include a family communication step.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 is the quantitative primary hypothesis.
